title: Rav Chana Petora’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Chullin 54b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.54b.5) he said, “Bar Nafcha was standing over me and asked me for Kurdinian dinars. I wanted to rise before him, but he would not let me. He said, ‘Sit, my son, sit,’” and so on. Hyman suggests that Bar Nafcha may be Rabbi Yochanan, as in [Bava Metzia 85b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.85b.8).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Chullin text gives Rabbi Chana and a single dinar, which Bar Nafcha used as a measure. Hyman’s heading gives Rav and his account has the plural. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Chullin.54b.5.1) explains that Chana was a money changer with many coins in front of him.
